timeline_reviews.summary: Reviewed stream transport source; no semantic events were projected from this transport-only file.
Reviewed serial agent trajectory: local probes, source writes, compile script, rebuilds, and comparison harness results.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the cleanroom reverse-engineering task, the Cppcheck 2.19 identity, and the need to observe behavior only through allowed CLI interactions.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Created a dynamic workflow that split black-box probing across many areas and planned a later synthesis specification while the parent began a local skeleton.
parallel.implementation: Captured help and errorlist data, generated embedded data, and wrote some C++ foundation files, but did not complete a buildable integrated implementation path.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact members contained source files and an executable, but the submitted tree lacked the required compile script and artifact validation was false.
parallel.verification: The workflow produced extensive probe observations, but no integrated local build and evaluator-aligned test pass is visible before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The agent timed out, workflow retrieval was incomplete, artifact validation failed, official evaluation compile_failed, and all 2550 tests were not run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same cleanroom task and used only the provided executable and bundled documentation as the behavioral oracle.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept probing, implementation, packaging, and verification in one main-agent path with workflows and delegation disabled.
serial.implementation: Wrote a C++ source tree including command-line parsing, project handling, preprocessing/tokenization, checks, logging, static data, and executor code.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Created compile.sh, built build/executable, moved it to executable, and submitted an artifact that validation accepted.
serial.verification: Ran a local comparison harness, reached 102/102 matches on the first CLI set, then 960/988 matches on an expanded corpus before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run also timed out and remained incomplete; official evaluation ran but ended at 712 passed, 1707 failed, 128 skipped, and 3 not_run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel prompt and early trajectory show the same cleanroom requirements and Cppcheck identity were recognized.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial prompt is identical and the serial trajectory worked from the executable and bundled docs under the same restrictions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; the difference is how each run converted requirements into a buildable deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into many probe areas plus a synthesis workflow while the parent started a skeleton.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained single-agent ownership of probing, source edits, compile script, build, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel allocated large breadth before closure; serial used one continuous owner for implementation and packaging.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs asked each probe to write reports under /tmp/probe and return compact summaries for later synthesis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept observations in its own trajectory and directly edited the implementation from that context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No missing or conflicting interface contract is proven; the issue is the volume and timing of reports relative to final delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created foundation source files and embedded data but did not complete the package mechanics needed for evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced a fuller source tree, project handling, checks, a compile script, and an executable that artifact validation accepted.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached a buildable partial implementation; parallel left an implementation tree that official evaluation could not compile.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow journal shows twenty-one child starts and only one recorded result before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; it inspected its own command outputs and immediately revised code.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel accumulated unresolved child work; serial avoided join/retrieval risk by keeping result consumption local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used shared workspace sources and /tmp/probe reports, but no concrete write collision is proven; the final artifact lacked build validity.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the same workspace coherently from one actor and produced compile.sh, build, and executable entries in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The important shared-state difference is delivery closure, not a demonstrated concurrent overwrite or contamination event.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel official evaluation completed with compile_failed and 2550 not_run tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial locally matched 102/102 CLI cases, later 960/988 cases, and official evaluation ran 2550 tests with 712 passes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verified an executable against the reference before official evaluation; parallel never reached evaluator-runnable acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed its 2400-second cell budget with a returncode 143 timeout after broad workflow fan-out.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but it had already closed a buildable artifact and generated local comparison evidence.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The same wall-clock limit produced much worse closure in parallel because broad probe fan-out displaced final build/package completion.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official outcomes are failures. The meaningful contrast is that the parallel run failed before tests because its submitted artifact was not buildable, while the serial run produced a valid artifact and partial executable that official evaluation could test.
parallel_contributors: A broad parallel probe workflow started many child probes and only one recorded child result before closure.
The parent did not complete the build/package path: artifact validation was false and official evaluation reported compile_failed.
serial_contributors: The serial agent wrote compile.sh and a runnable executable in the artifact.
The serial agent ran comparison checks before timeout and official evaluation exercised the submitted binary.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The serial implementation was still incomplete and failed most official tests despite compiling.
The parallel implementation source tree may contain ordinary coding incompleteness, but official testing did not reach those behaviors because compilation/package validation failed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported comparative contributors to the coverage gap in a both-fail pair, not an exclusive root-cause claim.

candidates.reason: Rejected: the parent actively started implementation work after the probe launch, so the problem was not absence of an implementation owner.
Rejected: there were not multiple completed component implementations requiring reconciliation under separate owners.
Rejected: the parent/orchestrator implicitly owned delivery and the failure is better explained by not reaching packaging before timeout.
Rejected: the run had an end-to-end path in the parent plus workflow synthesis; the observed failure is exhausted closure time, not no pipeline owner.
Rejected: productive implementation began while probes were still running, so work was not blocked behind one mandatory serial gate.
Rejected: the parallel probe work overlapped with parent implementation rather than completing as a separate investigation phase.
Rejected as same-chain: implementation was pressured, but the specific observed allocation boundary is broad fan-out budget exhaustion.

Retained: the workflow fanned out a dozen probe areas, the journal shows twenty-one child starts with only one recorded result, and the finite run window ended before a buildable delivery path closed; serial handled the corresponding build and local checks in one trajectory.
candidates.realized_consequence: Parallel did not finish a buildable submission package; artifact validation failed and official evaluation reported compile_failed with all tests not_run.
candidates.near_match_reason: Implementation capacity was affected, but the directly evidenced allocation event was collective breadth and retrying child probes rather than generic starvation.

Rejected: children produced behavior reports, not separately owned implementation components with an omitted interoperability contract.

Rejected: the one completed report was long, but the record does not show a parent decision point where available bulk prevented reduction; the broader fan-out timed out.
Rejected: there is no evidence that a receiver acted on obsolete workspace, requirement, dependency, or decision state.
Rejected: there are no incompatible returned reports or contracts shown reaching the parent and remaining unadjudicated.
Rejected: the parent did not present or accept the whole task as complete; the final response is empty and the process timed out.
Rejected: duplicate workflow starts are visible, but no replacement is shown repeating prior work because it lacked an inherited checkpoint.

candidates.reason: Rejected as same-chain: child interruptions are downstream of the broad workflow/time limit and are not a separate corrective boundary from fan-out exhaustion.
Rejected: no complete directly packageable candidate or mutually compatible finished component set is shown waiting for late promotion.
Rejected: no child result or implementation change was integrated after a relevant integrated verification pass.
Rejected: delegated work was probing/reporting, not a completed implementation that the parent failed to retrieve and join.
Rejected: no concrete verifier finding is trapped below the parent outside the same fan-out exhaustion episode.
Rejected as same-chain: child failures and cancellations were not separately resumed, but the direct episode is collective fan-out consuming the closure window.
Rejected: the workflow returned one completed report, but the record does not show a later parent decision inconsistent with an inspected available result.
Rejected: the parent did not merely wait without inspection; it launched probes and wrote implementation pieces, with fan-out exhaustion the more specific boundary.
Rejected: no concurrent agents are shown writing competing implementation files with overlapping behavior that required reconciliation.
Rejected: there is no observed same-file edit by two live agents and no reconciliation of such a race.
Rejected: no actor is shown replacing, deleting, or wholesale rewriting another actor owned non-entry source file.

Rejected: shared workspace access existed, but no concrete unstable-state or provenance problem from concurrent writes is proven.
Rejected: probe files under /tmp/probe were intended observations, and no generated artifact is shown contaminating reference behavior or verification input.

retained_patterns.reason: Retained: the workflow fanned out a dozen probe areas, the journal shows twenty-one child starts with only one recorded result, and the finite run window ended before a buildable delivery path closed; serial handled the corresponding build and local checks in one trajectory. Corrective boundary: cap probe fan-out or require an early buildable checkpoint before launching/retrying more probes.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel run did not finish a buildable submission; artifact validation failed and official evaluation compile_failed with all tests not_run.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: Critical-path implementation pressure was present, but the more specific observed allocation event was excessive workflow breadth exhausting budget before delivery.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Critical-Path Starvation, Oversized Child Task, Early Child Termination, Missing Verifier Return, No Failure Takeover, and Blind Timeout Wait were all considered as downstream symptoms of the same broad workflow/time-limit chain and not retained separately.
No Missing Owner label was retained because the parent/orchestrator path supplied ownership even though it failed to close before timeout.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no additional independent coordination boundary cleared the retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Only the fan-out budget episode was retained because other plausible timeout, child cancellation, join, and monitoring labels reused the same anchors and consequence.
